integrity: A complete proof with finite-state transfer, symbolic identities and exact extremal recurrence is included. Standalone finite checker is reproducible but not a substitute for infinite proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only three-adic valuations of four-ary Fuss–Catalan integers on full ternary index intervals; does not give unit residues or all-prime results. Historical priority of explicit formula awaits independent review.
title: Exact ternary valuation spectra of four-ary Fuss–Catalan numbers
